title: Symmetry of Solutions and Domain-Reduction Finite Element Method for Second-Order Linear Elliptic Dirichlet Boundary Value Problems on Bounded Domains
summary: Combining classical group theory and partial differential equation theory, this paper investigates the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(u)$ of the unique solution $u$ to the second-order linear elliptic boundary value problem on an $n$-dimensional bounded domain $Ω$ $-\sum_{i,j=1}^{n} a_{ij}(x)u_{x_ix_j} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} b_i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u = f(x), x\in Ω$, $u(x) = h(x), x\in \partial Ω$, The following symmetry groups are defined and characterized respectively: the symmetry group $\operatorname{Sym}(A)$ of the second-order coefficient matrix function $A(x)=(a_{ij}(x))_{n\times n}$; the…
